coverage_of_risk.rationale: No tests exist in app/ at all, so none of the risky logic — filtering, pagination, sorting, species mapping, cache — is covered by the app's own suite.

evidence: tests/specs/*.mjs — the only behavioural coverage is the external acceptance suite, which the app didn't write
behaviour_not_implementation.rationale: With no tests there are no assertions of any kind, behavioural or otherwise.

evidence: app/src/routes/index.tsx:16-25,52-60 — URL-param serialization and page clamping would regress silently
app/src/components/moves-table.tsx:36-45 — a one-character comparator change (e.g. dropping `* dir`) passes everything the app owns
app/src/lib/api.ts:36-41 — cache eviction (full clear on overflow) has no safety net
regression_power.rationale: Nothing in app/ can fail, so any refactor of the data layer ships unverified; the only guard is the external acceptance suite, which the repo may not keep.

evidence: app/src — no tests, hence no padding or duplication either
signal_to_noise.rationale: Per the anchored scale, a repo with no tests is neutral on this criterion: no noise, but no signal.

findings.issue: No test infrastructure at all: no `test` script, no Vitest (the framework's de-facto unit runner, `qwik add vitest` / `@builder.io/qwik/testing`) and no config, so `app/` cannot run a single test of its own.
findings.suggestion: Add Vitest with the qwikVite plugin plus a `test` script, and start with unit tests for `src/lib/format.ts` and `src/lib/api.ts`, which are already pure/isolated and trivially testable.

findings.issue: The most-reused pure helpers — humanize, idFromUrl's URL regex, latestFlavorText's whitespace collapse, orDash, dexNumber padding — are completely untested, and every page's naming and formatting flows through them.
findings.suggestion: Table-driven unit tests for these: `mr-mime` → `Mr Mime`, `#0025` padding, em-dash for null power, `\f`/`\n` collapse, trailing-slash and slashless API URLs.

findings.issue: The riskiest interactive logic in the app — sort direction flipping, missing-values-last in both directions, numeric vs lexicographic comparison, and the name tie-break — has zero coverage; a subtle comparator regression would ship silently.
findings.suggestion: Component tests via `createDOM()` asserting rendered row order and `aria-sort` after clicks, plus plain unit tests for the comparator (it is currently buried inside `useComputed$`; extract it to make it testable).

findings.issue: `speciesIndex` reconstructs each Pokémon's slot-ordered types from type→pokemon edges (`slots[entry.slot - 1] = type.name`) and joins them to species and generations; this cross-endpoint stitching drives the home filters, type badges and generation filter, and is untested.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with small fixture payloads: two-slot Pokémon, slot-1-only, a species absent from a type's list, and the alternate-form exclusion (`id >= 10000`).

findings.issue: Pagination and filtering math (substring match on the humanized label, `Math.ceil/PAGE_SIZE`, clamping an out-of-range or NaN `page`) is untested; an off-by-one in `slice((page-1)*48, page*48)` or a dropped clamp would silently show wrong cards.
findings.suggestion: Extract the filter/paginate step into a pure function and unit-test: empty q, `page=999`, `page=abc`, exact multiple of 48, zero matches.

findings.issue: `cardsForPokemon` maps Pokémon references to species names, drops alternate forms and dedups by species id; the `species.get(id) ?? ref.pokemon.name` fallback and the `< 10000` cut are only exercised for the few cases the acceptance suite happens to sample.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with refs including deoxys-normal (386), a mega form (id > 10000) and a ref whose species is unknown.

findings.issue: The in-memory cache's overflow path does `cache.clear()` after failing to evict expired entries, discarding every fresh entry too, and negative (404) results are cached for a full TTL; no test pins this behaviour or its limits.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test the cache with an injected clock: TTL expiry, rejection eviction, overflow behaviour; consider an LRU or raising the threshold before wholesale clearing.

findings.issue: Version-group discovery, ordering by `order`, default-to-latest selection, the `?game=` override and the `${method}:${level}` dedup key are all untested; flipping the sort or changing the fallback default would silently pick the oldest game.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with fixture `version_group_details`: several groups with different `order`, a group missing from the move list, an invalid `?game=` value, and duplicate method/level pairs.

findings.issue: Non-404 API errors throw from route loaders with no custom 500 route and no test; a transient API failure surfaces as Qwik City's default error page with no chance to verify the layout survives.
findings.suggestion: Add a `routes/index@500.tsx` (or equivalent error route) and a test that mocks the API to return 500 and asserts a graceful error page.

findings.issue: The debounced search and the URL-sync task (guarded by `document.activeElement === searchRef.value`) is client-only interplay between debounce, focus and navigation; the guard's failure mode is wiping the user's in-progress typing after back/forward.
findings.suggestion: A Playwright test in the app itself driving type → navigate → back, asserting the input keeps the typed value; this is the kind of timing behaviour the acceptance suite only samples lightly.

summary: The app ships zero tests and zero test infrastructure — no runner, no config, no `test` script — so this dimension contributes nothing of its own; the only safety net is the external acceptance suite. The good news is that the riskiest logic is factored into pure, easily testable modules (`format.ts`, `api.ts`, the moves comparator and the list filter/paginate step), so a first round of Vitest tests would be cheap and high-yield. Until then, any refactor of sorting, pagination, species mapping or the API cache is unverified.

untested.area: Moves-table sorting (app/src/components/moves-table.tsx:22-46): ascending/descending flip, missing-values-last, numeric vs string comparison, name tie-break, aria-sort
untested.likelyBug: Dropping `* dir` or the `xMissing` branch makes Power/PP sort backwards or puts `—` first in one direction; nothing in app/ fails.

untested.area: Home-page filtering and pagination (app/src/routes/index.tsx:36-60): substring match on humanized names, type/generation filters, 48-per-page slice, page clamping, query serialization in listUrl
untested.likelyBug: Off-by-one in the slice, a lost clamp on `page=999`, or emitting `?q=&type=` instead of omitting defaults — the URL contract silently drifts.

untested.area: speciesIndex cross-endpoint stitching (app/src/lib/api.ts:100-125): type slots per Pokémon, generation membership, 18-type exclusion
untested.likelyBug: An off-by-one (`entry.slot` vs `entry.slot - 1`) or `.push` instead of indexed assignment reorders or drops a Pokémon's type badges and breaks the type filter.

untested.area: Formatting/localization helpers (app/src/lib/format.ts): humanize, dexNumber, idFromUrl, latestFlavorText, orDash
untested.likelyBug: A regex tweak in idFromUrl breaks species-name mapping everywhere; whitespace-collapse or em-dash regressions surface as wrong text on every page.

untested.area: cardsForPokemon species mapping (app/src/lib/api.ts:81-99): alternate-form exclusion (id >= 10000), dedup, name fallback
untested.likelyBug: Changing the `< 10000` bound or the dedup key reintroduces Mega/Gmax cards or drops a species that has two Pokémon entries.

untested.area: API response cache (app/src/lib/api.ts:17-42): 60s TTL, 404-as-null caching, rejection eviction, overflow clear
untested.likelyBug: The overflow `cache.clear()` discards fresh entries, causing a burst of thousands of refetches; a TTL change to Infinity would freeze the live-data overlay the spec's tests rely on.

untested.area: Pokémon moves game selection (app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/index.tsx:60-96): group ordering by `order`, default to highest, `?game=` override, method/level dedup
untested.likelyBug: A flipped sort silently defaults every Pokémon to the oldest game; a changed dedup key produces duplicate rows per sub-game.

untested.area: API error paths (app/src/lib/api.ts:27-28): non-404 failures throw from loaders, no custom 500 route
untested.likelyBug: A transient upstream 500 or timeout renders the framework's raw error page instead of the branded shell, with no test to catch it.

untested.area: Search debounce and URL-sync interaction (app/src/routes/index.tsx:50-96): 150ms timer, replace-vs-push, focus guard in useTask$
untested.likelyBug: A broken `document.activeElement` guard wipes in-progress typing on back/forward; a dropped `clearTimeout` fires a stale navigation after a select change.
